title: Fix S Plugin Build for Framework OS Dev
description: The s-plugin crate fails to compile in framework-os-dev:dev because it imports MeasureSelectItem and WindowEngagementStatus via semio_framework_plugin::component::layout, which no longer exists after the layout components moved into ui_wgpu and are re-exported flatly by semio_framework_plugin. Fix the imports and verify the s app works end to end via the dev server.
